phases.name: Phase 1 — Forward (9 screens in order)
phases.description: Clicks every visible, enabled button on each screen in forward order. Returns to the screen after each click.

phases.name: Phase 2 — Backward (reverse screen order)
phases.description: Clicks every visible, enabled button in reverse screen order. Skips onboarding screens.

phases.name: Phase 3 — Modal testing
phases.description: Opens each modal, tests buttons inside, closes. Tests close buttons.

phases.name: Phase 4 — Map function
phases.description: Loads Palm Springs city data, toggles Map View, checks Leaflet availability, marker count, and errors. Toggles back to List View.

tests.name: Map Library (Leaflet)
tests.description: L defined and L.map is a function

tests.name: Color Contrast
tests.description: WCAG AA ratio check on main colors
